# Style Mirror Test Fixtures

Writing samples for the Style Mirror quality gate (Phase 3).

## Required files (to be added in Phase 3)

Provide 20+ samples of the author's writing across contexts:
- `email_samples.txt` — professional emails
- `doc_samples.md` — markdown documents
- `chat_samples.txt` — casual messages

Each sample should be 100–500 words of original writing. The Style Mirror
model is evaluated by embedding similarity (≥ 0.82) and blind human review.
